"""Original-budget controls, with no profiling or synchronous-elaboration override."""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import subprocess
import time

parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument('--runner',type=Path,default=Path('scripts/benchmark-classification-clients.py'))
parser.add_argument('--specialized',type=Path,required=True)
parser.add_argument('--direct',type=Path,required=True)
parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
args=parser.parse_args()
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('clients',args.runner.resolve())
b=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(b)
workspaces={'specialized':args.specialized.resolve(),'direct':args.direct.resolve()}
report={'time_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'timeout':30,
        'instrumentation':'none; original Elab.async option', 'results':[],
        'script':Path(__file__).read_text(),
        'script_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
report['inputs']={k:b.inputs(w) for k,w in workspaces.items()}
for name in b.CLIENTS:
    for label,recursion in [('specialized',None),('direct',1024)]:
        command=['lake','env','lean']
        if recursion is not None: command.append(f'-DmaxRecDepth={recursion}')
        command.append(f'Examples/{name}.lean')
        t=time.perf_counter()
        p=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=workspaces[label],text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                           stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
        try:
            output,_=p.communicate(timeout=30)
            failures=[tag for tag,marker in [('recursion','maximum recursion depth'),
                      ('heartbeats','maximum number of heartbeats')] if marker in output]
            status='pass' if p.returncode==0 else '+'.join(failures) or 'error'
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
            output,_=p.communicate()
            status='timeout'
        row={'client':name,'workspace':label,'command':command,'status':status,
             'returncode':p.returncode,'wall_seconds':time.perf_counter()-t,'diagnostics':output}
        report['results'].append(row)
        args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
        print(label,name,status,row['wall_seconds'],flush=True)
for label,w in workspaces.items():
    if b.inputs(w)!=report['inputs'][label]: raise RuntimeError('changed inputs')
report['inputs_verified_after']=True
args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
